text: N252440May 7, 2014CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:356CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6105.20.2010Mr. Daniel ClanceyHomeschool Snowboarding 2127 N. Albina Avenue #401Portland, OR  97227         RE:	The tariff classification of a men’s knit shirt from China.   Dear Mr. Clancey:In your letter dated January 20, 2014, and in subsequent correspondence dated March 26, 2014, you requested a tariff classification.  As requested, the sample submitted will be returned.The submitted sample, Style GML14F16 “Hard Core Days Shirt,” is a men’s shirt constructed from 100% polyester, finely knit fabric that measures 17 stitches per linear centimeter counted in the horizontal direction and 11 stitches per linear centimeter counted in the vertical direction. The shirt has a U-shaped front; a neckline finished with self-fabric capping; a partial front opening with a left-over-right three snap closure; long, hemmed sleeves; a patch pocket on the left chest; a back yoke; and a straight, hemmed bottom.     Although you identify Style GML14F16 as a base layer /underwear item, in subheading 6109.90.1047, the construction of the garment is more indicative of a shirt.  In addition, specific catalog information was submitted with the item and indicates that the item is a multi-use garment.  Consequently, the applicable subheading for Style GML14F16 will be 6105.20.2010, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for men’s or boys’ shirts, knitted or crocheted: of man-made fibers: other: men’s. The rate of duty is 32% ad valorem. Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Rosemarie Hayward via e-mail at rosemariecasey.hayward@cbp.dhs.gov.Sincerely,Gwenn Klein KirschnerActing DirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of a men’s knit shirt from China.
